xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfAuditQualificationExp: We draw attention to Note 6 to the Statement, regarding concerns shared by the erstwhile Joint Managing Director regarding certain practices by the Chairman and Managing Director of the Company. Pursuant to the concerns raised, the Audit Committee has engaged an independent external agency to carry out an impact assessment for the same. Subsequent to the quarter ended 30 September, 2026, the draft preliminary observations report has recently been submitted by the external agency to the Management, which is under assessment by the Management and Audit Committee. Pending such assessment, we are unable to determine the effect, if any, that this matter may have on the accompanying Statement for the quarter and six month period ended 30 September, 2026.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:AuditQualificationsWhereTheImp: During the quarter ended 30 June, 2026, the erstwhile Joint Managing Director (JMD) of the Company, has shared certain concerns regarding specific practices by the Chairman and Managing Director of the Company. These concerns pertain to the period when the JMD himself was in office. The Audit Committee of the Company in its meeting held on 15 June, 2026 has appointed an independent external agency to carry out an impact assessment for the alleged concerns raised. Subsequent to the quarter ended 30 September, 2026, the draft preliminary observations report has recently been received from the external agency, which is being assessed by the Management and Audit Committee.
